title.rendered: DAAD Heilbronn AI Fellowships in Germany (Fully Funded)

excerpt.rendered: Applications are open for the DAAD Heilbronn AI Fellowships for researchers in artificial intelligence and machine learning.

content.rendered:
The fellowship supports postdoctoral researchers working on machine learning, including AI for healthcare and medical imaging. Monthly stipend of €2,670.

Deadline: 15th January 2027

Health insurance is covered.
